_doc: Model manifest for the asset pipeline (src/room/assets.ts; docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md). Each entry maps a `model` key (used by props in era1.json / reinterp_deltas.json) to a GLB file in assets/models/. EMPTY by design right now — with no entries, every prop renders as its colored box (current look, nothing breaks). Drop CC0 low-poly GLBs into public/assets/models/ (served at /assets/models/), list them here, and add `"model": "<key>"` to the matching props to swap boxes → real meshes. Palette law holds: models are recolored FLAT in code, no textures. Kit + licenses tracked in assets/LICENSES.md.

models._doc: Session 32 (R28-2b-ii): Sérgio's live-playtest fix for the box-built boombox reading misaligned on the Room 1 shelf. 'Casette Player' by Jason Toff, CC-BY via Poly Pizza (assets/LICENSES.md + docs/reinterp/ATTRIBUTIONS.md) — usable per D6. Native GLB bbox measured directly (single mesh, no viewer available): min[-0.378,-0.161,-0.334] max[0.362,0.049,0.157], so cx/cz/baseY below are that box's exact center/base, and `scale` is non-uniform to bring it down to a small period cassette-player footprint on the shelf (NOT a full twin-speaker boombox shape — the source model reads as a handheld deck). yaw is a first guess (0); re-check against a fresh screenshot before treating as final.
